ModMetaData.name: Shift Change
ModMetaData.author: AzraelGodKing
ModMetaData.description:
Automatic dress-for-task: when a colonist clocks into Sleep (and later work types / rituals), they walk to a wardrobe stockpile, change into the assigned apparel policy, and restore their previous clothes when the shift ends.
MVP: Sleep timetable → outfit policy + one stockpile zone + snapshot restore. Vanilla OptimizeApparel is suppressed while Shift Change is managing a pawn.
Requires Harmony. RimWorld 1.6. Safe to add mid-save.
